facts.name: dry run
facts.says: --dry-run is given

facts.name: undo
facts.says: --undo is given

facts.name: nothing to release
facts.says: no conventional commit of a visible type is left to release

facts.name: only hidden commits remain
facts.says: conventional commits are left, and every one is of a hidden or unmapped type

facts.name: no local tags
facts.says: the clone has no tags

facts.name: origin has tags
facts.says: origin can be asked for its tags and lists at least one

facts.name: trunk flow
facts.says: release.branch is not set

facts.name: origin names no default branch
facts.says: origin advertises no HEAD symref, or cannot be asked for it

facts.name: the release branch is on origin
facts.says: origin has a branch named by release.branch

facts.name: the last commit is a release commit
facts.says: HEAD carries a Release-Tag trailer

facts.name: the directory is not in a git repository
facts.says: no .git entry at or above the project directory

facts.name: there are no settings
facts.says: no .pk.json at the repository root

facts.name: settings are invalid
facts.says: a .pk.json with an unknown key or a value outside the allowed ones

facts.name: the working branch is unfit
facts.says: no branch checked out, a protected branch, or a branch that is behind origin or does not hold the last version tag

facts.name: no branch is checked out
facts.says: the working branch is unfit because HEAD is detached

facts.name: the branch is behind origin
facts.says: the working branch is unfit because origin's copy of it is not in its history

facts.name: only guard.branches protects the branch
facts.says: the working branch is unfit because guard.branches lists it, and it is not release.branch

facts.name: only release.branch protects the branch
facts.says: the working branch is unfit because it is release.branch, and guard.branches does not list it

facts.name: the branch is not the default
facts.says: in trunk flow, the branch is not origin's default branch

facts.name: the tree is dirty
facts.says: a tree with uncommitted changes

facts.name: a tag does not name a version
facts.says: a tag that does not name a version

facts.name: origin does not answer
facts.says: a remote that does not answer, or lacks the working branch

facts.name: the remote-tracking branches are stale
facts.says: a record of origin's branches that origin has moved past

facts.name: the release branch has diverged
facts.says: a branch that cannot be resolved, or has diverged from the working branch

facts.name: the changelog file cannot be read
facts.says: a CHANGELOG.md that cannot be read

facts.name: a version file has no version field
facts.says: a JSON file with no version field at its root

facts.name: origin has no address
facts.says: no address for origin, so the section gets no link

facts.name: the trailer is not a version
facts.says: a Release-Tag trailer on HEAD whose value does not parse and render back as a version
facts.only: the last commit is a release commit

facts.name: the last version tag is not in the branch's history
the --bump value is not a level
facts.says: --bump is given a value other than major, minor or patch

facts.name: an --exclude entry matches no commit
facts.says: --exclude names a hash that is not among the commits since the tag

facts.name: the changelog file cannot be written
facts.says: writing CHANGELOG.md fails

facts.name: the commit is pushed, tagged or merged
the reset fails
facts.says: git reset --hard HEAD~1 fails

facts.name: the switch to the release branch fails
facts.says: git switch to release.branch fails

facts.name: the release branch cannot be fast-forwarded
the push of the working branch fails
